static_traits.name: Wang Jie
static_traits.social_status: 有一起打游戏的朋友，但not yet与他们讨论这些情绪反应
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；过去not yet有类似问题；not yet接受过心理治疗或心理咨询
static_traits.language_features: 表达直接清晰，能具体描述情绪与自动化思维；能与咨询师合作并进行自我观察；在游戏情境中常use“非黑即白”的表述与灾难化语言；语速与逻辑Not mentioned；Neutral attitude

basic_info.main_problem: 我正在寻求咨询，以应对在视频游戏失败时出现的强烈情绪反应。问题始于昨晚在我最喜欢的游戏中连续输了三局，这让我把游戏光盘取出并摔碎，显示出强烈的负性情绪反应。我认为失败带来的压力trigger了这种反应。这种行为最近在升级，我在面对游戏挑战时倾向于全或without的思维模式。
basic_info.core_demands: “只要能让我在每次输掉游戏时not再出现这样的感受，我愿意尝试。”；并意识到“这种行为可能有问题，需要处理潜在的问题”。

core_beliefs: I have always been terrible at this game
失败说明我not该继续尝试

special_situations.event: Lost three games in a row in a favorite game last night
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果Losing consecutive matches，就证明我很差，继续玩have not意义
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 立刻终止游戏、把光盘摔碎以避免再次失败与Emotional loss of control
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我一直都会很糟糕，根本not可能再赢，玩下去也have not意义

special_situations.event: Losing a match when playing online with friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not赢，就说明我not行；我也要为团队失败负责
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Loses temper with friends or distances from them, plays together less to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得It is all my fault，我很差劲

special_situations.event: Focuses only on failures and mistakes when reviewing game performance after a match
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有赢才算好表现，其他都not值得一提
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate或忽视过去的Good发挥与游戏带来的乐趣
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 之前的好发挥都not算数，我就是很差

special_situations.event: After losing a match, emotions run high; prepares to rest yet cannot fall asleep
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Failure means serious consequences; it will make the whole night and tomorrow worse
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immersed in negative emotions and failure imagery, hard to self-soothe
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is like the end of the world; everything is terrible

core_conflict.wish: 渴望通过胜利Gaining recognition与自我价值感（把游戏表现视为身份的一部分）
core_conflict.fear: Fears failure leading to shame and the collapse of self-worth (feels like 'the end of the world')
defense_goal: 用全或without的方式保持控制与Self-protection，通过停止游戏、破坏光盘来避免继续体验失败与羞耻

object_relations.self_representation: When failing, regarding oneself as a 'bad player / failure'
object_relations.object_representation: Experiencing teammates/friends as others who might judge oneself (the other will blame or look down on oneself)

manifestations: 输掉时出现“有什么意义”式的念头（not再尝试、摔碎光盘）
Binds game performance to identity; winning and losing are magnified into proof of existential worth

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Strong self-blame and self-deprecation after losing a game ('I will always be terrible')
以全盘negate的方式评价自我价值（非黑即白）
将“输掉一次”扩大为“have not意义，not该再尝试”

exception_events.target_problem: 在输掉视频游戏时，来访者通常会Emotional loss of control、全盘negate自我并采取冲动行为（如摔碎光盘），且随后出现Sleep disturbed与对朋友发脾气。
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在Work中如果犯错，来访者会及时修正并继续Work，have not像在游戏中那样强烈失控或Self-denial。
exception_events.reason: 情境not同：Work中的错误被视为not那么“个人化”；做法not同：聚焦问题解决而非输赢评价；因此这次情绪更可控、结果更好。

positive_force: In work situations, able to adopt problem-solving strategies and maintain emotional stability
有一定的自我观察能力，能识do not并描述负性自动化思维
Willing to try new methods and cooperate with counseling (willing to record and practice)
Has some social support (friends who game together)
negative_force: 非黑即白思维与灾难化/预测not yet来倾向
negate积极经验（忽略曾经的Good发挥与游戏乐趣）
Personalization and internalizing failure as low self-worth
Strongly binds game performance to self-identity, causing wins and losses to be excessively amplified
Lacks effective emotion regulation and coping strategies; after failure, strongly loses control, affecting sleep and interpersonal relations

target_behavior.behavior: 在输掉游戏后出现强烈Emotional loss of control与Impulsively damaging objects（如摔碎光盘）
antecedent: Still immersed in failure emotions after the match
target_behavior.core_reason: 将输赢与自我价值强绑定，出现非黑即白与灾难化/预测not yet来的认知（“永远not会赢”），由此引发羞耻与Sense of frustration，缺乏有效的情绪调节策略
target_behavior.function: 逃避not愉快情绪并寻求短暂的控制感/释放Sense of frustration
target_behavior.consequence: 失去游戏设备与乐趣、情绪进一步恶化、Sleep disturbed

target_behavior.behavior: 在游戏失败后对朋友/队友发脾气或强烈挫败，影响Interpersonal relationships
antecedent: Losing a match in online multiplayer
队友出现失误或比赛not顺利
target_behavior.core_reason: Personalization and mind-reading explanations (attributing failure to herself, assuming negative evaluations from others), evaluating self-worth by winning and losing
target_behavior.function: Reducing self-blame and shame through outward venting and blaming others
target_behavior.consequence: Tense relationships with friends、Reduced socializing支持、进一步加剧负性情绪体验
